<solar/>Firesprite pickups grant <solar/>Restoration x1 for 2 seconds (3 with <solar/>Ember of Solace). Extends <solar/>Restoration's duration by the same amount if it's already active.

Collecting a <solar/>Firesprite while <solar/>Restoration's timer is above 15 seconds will lower it back down to 15 seconds.

Reviving allies grants you and allies within ? meters <solar/>Restoration x1 for 5 seconds (7.5 with <solar/>Ember of Solace).
